title: Office Restoration
summary: Original floors and a reclaimed wood door in the author's 1894 home.
searchSummary: Office documentation tracks the first floor-refinishing method used in the house, sanding progression, hand-applied polyurethane, trim work, and reclamation of an original solid-wood door.
stage: Room restored and returned to use in the documented record
recorded: Floor work documented December 2021–January 2022; door reclamation recorded under 2022; planning archive added August 2026.
sourceLabel: Office journal and two Flickr albums
introduction: Original floorboards and a worn solid-wood door were retained as this room in the author's 1894 home became a dedicated office. The work combined progressive sanding, hand-applied water-based polyurethane, and a separate reclaimed-door finish.
evidenceBoundary: Album counts are recorded local inventory values, not live platform verification. The selected photographs are migration candidates awaiting editorial review.
